    """
    Horizontal fill (gap >= 2): Both bounding 2s need diagonal support (on the OUTSIDE).
    Vertical fill (gap = 1): At least one bounding 2 needs diagonal support (TOP pointing),
    and bounds must NOT be adjacent to grid edge.
    
    Diagonal support means: (r-1, c-1) == 2 AND (r-1, c+1) == 2
    """
    rows, cols = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    result = [row[:] for row in grid]
    
    # Horizontal fill
    for r in range(rows):
        twos = [c for c in range(cols) if grid[r][c] == 2]
        for i in range(len(twos) - 1):
            c1, c2 = twos[i], twos[i+1]
            gap = c2 - c1 - 1
            if gap >= 2:
                # Diagonal support on OUTSIDE edges
                left_has_diag = (r > 0 and r < rows-1 and 
                                grid[r-1][c1-1] == 2 and grid[r+1][c1-1] == 2)
                right_has_diag = (r > 0 and r < rows-1 and 
                                 grid[r-1][c2+1] == 2 and grid[r+1][c2+1] == 2)
                
                if left_has_diag and right_has_diag:
                    for c in range(c1+1, c2):
                        if grid[r][c] == 0:
                            result[r][c] = 1

    for c in range(cols):
        twos = [r for r in range(rows) if grid[r][c] == 2]
        for i in range(len(twos) - 1):
            r1, r2 = twos[i], twos[i+1]
